verdict.rationale: Rootly documents the incident timeline as the authoritative chronological record. It aggregates updates from people, systems, automations and communication channels, and Meeting Scribe attaches a speaker-labeled bridge-call record to the incident. For editing afterwards, retrospectives auto-draft a Curated Timeline from incident data, the Slack channel and transcripts, inside a collaborative rich-text editor where it can be revised. Missing for 10: explicit docs on editing or annotating timeline events directly, explicit confirmation that alerts and chat decisions land as timeline entries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
